name: Cleveland (United States)
description: Three vertical stripes of red, white and blue; the white stripe bears a shield with the city's industrial and maritime emblems above the year 1796.
history: Designed by 18-year-old Susan Hepburn and adopted in 1896, the year of Cleveland's centennial.

features.role: shield with anvil, windlass and laurel, inscribed 'Progress & Prosperity'
